description: Create a new portal for collecting files from external users. Portals can be configured with access codes, download passwords, file type restrictions, custom branding, connected integrations, and more. Only 'name' and 'subdomain' are required - all other settings are optional.

access_code.description: Access code for portal (required if has_access_code is true)

access_level.description: Portal access level: 'regular' for public access, 'private' for restricted access

access_list.description: Array of membership IDs for users with direct access to private portal. Use get_team_members to retrieve membership IDs

active.description: Whether portal is active and accepting uploads

background_url.description: URL of background image for portal

cc_recipients.description: Email addresses that receive carbon copy notifications without download link

custom_expiry_days.description: Custom expiry days for packages (-1 for unlimited)

download_password.description: Download password (required if has_download_password is true)

download_user_authentication_required.description: Whether users must authenticate to download

expiry.description: Portal expiry date (ISO 8601 format). This parameter is required when expiry_enabled: true

expiry_enabled.description: Whether portal expiry is enabled. If set to true, need to also provide expiry parameter, e.g. expiry: '2027-01-01'

file_type_restriction_enabled.description: Whether file type restrictions are enabled

file_type_restriction_exclude.description: Whether to exclude (true) or include (false) specified file types

file_types.description: Allowed/excluded file extensions prefixed with dots (e.g., ['.mp4', '.mov'])

has_access_code.description: Whether portal requires an access code to upload (if true, you also need to specify access_code parameter)

has_download_password.description: Whether portal packages require password to download (if true, you also need to specify download_password parameter)

logo_url.description: URL of logo image for portal

max_file_count.description: Maximum number of files per upload (0 for unlimited). Only works when package_size_restriction_enabled: true

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size in bytes (0 for unlimited). Only works when package_size_restriction_enabled: true

max_package_size.description: Maximum package size in bytes (0 for unlimited). Only works when package_size_restriction_enabled: true

package_name_format.description: Custom package naming format configuration (required when package_name_format_enabled is true)

label.description: Label shown to users explaining the required package name format (e.g., 'Format For Videos')

value.description: Regex pattern used to enforce package name format (e.g., '^sd{2}_ed{2}$')

package_name_format_enabled.description: Whether custom package naming format is enabled

package_size_restriction_enabled.description: Whether package size restrictions are enabled. Set to true in order to set max_file_count, max_file_size or max_package_size

primary_color.description: Primary color for portal branding (hex color code)

recipients.description: Email addresses that receive notifications for portal uploads

teamspace_id.description: ID of teamspace to associate portal with

terms_of_service.description: Terms of service configuration (required when terms_of_service_enabled is true)

checkbox_url.description: URL to full terms of service document or any other additional information

description.description: Description or content of the terms of service

title.description: Title of the terms of service

terms_of_service_enabled.description: Whether terms of service acceptance is required to upload to the portal

user_authentication_required.description: Whether to restrict Portal upload to only team users with proper access. Users must authenticate to upload

name: create_portal
title: Create a portal to collect files
